about: The edit-keys table: one definition for Linux (embed_edit_keys_e2e.sh), macOS (mac_pane_e2e.py) and Windows (win_embed_e2e.py). Each row is pressed with real OS key events (XTest, CGEvent/VNC, SendInput) with the keyboard in the embedded editor's canvas (a click on an empty part of it first), in the PCB editor and then the schematic editor. Verdicts: works, nothing (no edit event, no file change, no window within wait_s), wrong (something else happened: the opposite edit, an agent's item undone, a file not written, another window). Judged only from KiCad's own edit events (ET_DOCUMENT_EDITED, its detail's created and deleted counts; ET_SELECTION_CHANGED), KiCad's windows and the files on disk, never pixels and never the modified flag (its event trails the edit). Rows marked gating fail the suite on anything but works; a nothing on undo, redo, cut/copy/paste, delete or save goes to the lead and the integrator at once.
setup: Each row starts from the full board (or sheet): what a row deletes is undone with Ctrl+Z / Cmd+Z only after the undo rows have passed; when undo is nothing the rows that need it are judged on a fresh copy or ordered to need no undo (say which).

keys.macos: Cmd+A, fn+Delete, Cmd+Z, Cmd+Shift+Z (Cmd+Y is n/a on macOS), Cmd+Z

rows.after: a check run (DRC / ERC) so its markers are on the canvas and in select all
rows.works: with a check run and an agent's read through the hub (kicad_ipc GetItems) between each step: every real item back at each undo (GetItems counts per kind, markers aside, equal to the start), all deleted at the delete and the redo, every agent read answered, and no new KiCad window (dialog) at any point
rows.wrong: a real item missing after an undo, a dialog, or an agent read refused
rows.how: Linux and Windows count and check over KiCad's socket (GetItems, RunChecks); macOS reaches KiCad only through the hub, so its counts are the hub's kicad_ipc GetItems (that call is also the agent read) and its check the hub's RunChecks, else KiCad's own check after each edit (ET_CHECKS_DONE), the output saying which
